Reflects costs — what was spent, lost, or permanently altered.

Does not immediately launch another cliffhanger or introduce a new threat.

DM-facing content is concrete and grounded in wiki facts.
Output includes what changed, costs, and what players can now pursue.
Scope is proportional to the Climax.
